soft daylight beige-grey (background exterior through window)

visual_complexity_notes: The set is a single, moderately detailed but static kitchen backdrop - realistic stop-motion clutter (dishes, canisters, fruit bowl, knife block) gives it texture and lived-in believability, but the camera framing keeps both characters and the tea/dish props as the sole focal points throughout, with no scene changes or camera relocation. This is a deliberate minimal-location, high-repetition format (consistent with a daily episodic series) that keeps visual complexity low relative to a real kitchen so all comedic focus stays on the two characters' expressions and dialogue rather than the environment.
